These eight fictional seedling records demonstrate how a document connects
research data, code and output. Each row is one tagged seedling followed over
one observation interval. Diameter is the initial stem diameter in millimetres.

```{r import}
seedlings <- read.csv("data/seedlings.csv")
head(seedlings)
```

One diameter measurement is missing. This histogram counts only the seven
recorded measurements; missing diameter is not a diameter of zero.

```{r diameter-plot, fig.width=7, fig.height=4}
hist(
  seedlings$diameter_mm,
  breaks = c(0, 2, 4, 6, 8),
  main = "Initial seedling stem diameter",
  xlab = "Stem diameter (mm)",
  ylab = "Number of seedlings",
  col = "#1b9e77",
  border = "white"
)
```

The CSV stays unchanged when we render this document. The HTML is an output;
the QMD records how to recreate it.
